name: Salt shaker
summary: Glass salt shaker full of white salt with a silver dome cap and holes; for dining table and kitchen scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the shaker stands on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the shaker is hero size (~320 px wide); use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down, pop = scale in with overshoot

author: krakujs
